name: TFT Set 18
source: Units, stats and trait numbers from the game data of patch 18.5 (CommunityDragon); ability and item numbers from tft.tools and Riot's patch notes, as of patch 18.5c.

ability.name: Kunai Strike
ability.desc: Adaptor AD: Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing 145/220/380/645 AD + 10/15/25/40 AP physical damage. If the target is Burning, deal an additional 35/52/80/135 AD damage. Adaptor AP: If the Ability kills, cast it again.

ability.name: Defensive Sweep
ability.desc: Slice the target for 150/225/400/665 AD + 10/15/25/40 AP physical damage and gain 60/90/200/310 Shield for 2 seconds.

ability.name: Razor Leaves
ability.desc: Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of 310/465/700/1200 AD + 30/45/70/115 AP physical damage and applying 20% Wound and 1% Burn for 4 seconds. Scarlet Buff: Cinderling gains 22% Attack Damage each cast.

alphaAd.label: Scarlet Buff: Attack Damage per cast

ability.name: Karmic Bond
ability.desc: Tether the current target, dealing 280/420/630/1070 AP magic damage over 1.5 seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing 120/180/270/460 AP magic damage to all enemies in a 1 Hex radius and 30% Slowing them for 2 seconds.

ability.name: Dance of Life
ability.desc: Restore 49/88/159/229 Health + 285/335/480/595 AP Health over 2 seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals 70/126/226.8/327.6 Health + 70/105/150/0 AP magic damage.

ability.name: Shield Bash
ability.desc: Passive: Start combat with 60/80/100/130 AP bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over 12 seconds. Active: Bash the current target, dealing 60/108/162/320 Armor magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

ability.name: Bellows Breath
ability.desc: Active: Gain 400/460/550/640 AP Shield for 4 seconds and deal 200/300/450/765 AP magic damage to enemies in a cone. Quest: Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, doubled at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power.

ability.name: Azure Laser
ability.desc: Begin consuming 35% max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal 160/240/360/615 AP magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by 3. Teal Buff: Gain 2 Mana Regen for every 4 seconds channeled.

alphaRegen.label: Teal Buff: Mana Regen per 4 s channeled

ability.name: Entrancing Dance
ability.desc: Gain 290/340/435/510 AP Shield for 4 seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat 90%/100%/130%/160% AP decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

as_.label: Decaying Attack Speed for the top damage dealer

ability.name: Uproot
ability.desc: Passive: Restore 7/13/23/33 Health + 10/14/20/26 Health each second, tripled for 3 seconds after casting. Active: Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for 1 second and dealing 70/105/160/270 AP magic damage to them.

ability.name: Piercing Arrow
ability.desc: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals 415/625/1000/1700 AD + 30/45/70/115 AP physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by 40% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 40%).

ability.name: Primordial Burst
ability.desc: Launch a giant blast at the target that deals 190/285/430/725 AP magic damage, increased to 285/430/640/1000 AP if they're below 30% max Health. If they die, permanently gain 3% Ability Power.

ability.name: Deadly Plumage
ability.desc: Gain 50% Attack Speed for the next 5 attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal 73/108/165/175 AD physical damage and reduce Armor by 2 AP.

ability.name: Last Rites
ability.desc: Passive: On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with 200/400/750/1100 + 130/234/421/608 Health max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it. Active: Restore 280/325/435/545 AP Health and strike the target, dealing 150/225/340/575 AD physical damage.

ability.name: Triumphant Roar
ability.desc: Roar, restoring 76/137/246 Health + 230/300/400 AP Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for 80/105/130 AP. Then slam the current target, dealing 180/270/420 AP magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

ability.name: Headshot
ability.desc: Passive: Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals 200/300/490 AD + 20/30/45 AP physical damage.

every.label: Every nth attack is a Headshot

ability.name: Spider Queen
ability.desc: Transform into a spider and gain 375/475/725 max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal 35/50/80 AP bonus magic damage and heal for 55/90/170 AP. Subsequent casts grant 175% decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

as_.label: Decaying Attack Speed on later casts

ability.name: Belchy Bubble
ability.desc: Adaptor AP: Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 225/340/535 AP magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius of the explosion take 180/270/435 AP magic damage over 3 seconds. Adaptor AD: Heavily slows the target. Purple Buff: Every 5 seconds, Gromp gains 30% Ability Power.

alphaAp.label: Purple Buff: Ability Power every 5 s

ability.name: Solar Judgement
ability.desc: Passive: Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 1st Ascension: Attacks deal 65/97/110 AP bonus magic damage. 2nd Ascension: Attacks 20% Shred enemies hit for 2 seconds. 3rd Ascension: Attacks fire waves, dealing 35 AP magic damage to all other units hit. 4th Ascension: Gain infinite range. Every 3rd wave is much larger.

ability.name: Mirror Image
ability.desc: Passive: After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a 10%/15%/40% chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by 4% per takedown. Active: Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing 260/390/615 AP magic damage and 100/150/230 AP to adjacent enemies.

ability.name: Rending Claws
ability.desc: Leap to the lowest Health enemy within 3 Hexes and deal 100/150/225 AD + 20/30/45 AP physical damage. The next 2 attacks gain 175% Attack Speed and deal 65/100/160 AD bonus physical damage. Grey Buff: Gain Precision and 25% Critical Strike Chance, increased up to 75% based on missing Health.

alphaCritMax.label: Grey Buff: most Critical Strike Chance

ability.name: Can You Dig It?
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals 50/75/112.5 AD physical damage to all adjacent enemies. Active: Burrow underground, gaining 15% Durability for 3 seconds and healing 325/400/675 AP over the duration. Green Buff: When allies fall below 50% Health, they restore 15% max Health.

ability.name: Sun's Wrath
ability.desc: Gain 90/162/291.6 Health + 225/250/275 AP Shield for 4 seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing 90/135/205 AP magic damage and strike in a line, dealing 120/180/270 AP magic damage to enemies hit.

ability.name: Ki Barrier
ability.desc: Grant 375/450/575 AP Shield to Shen and 225/300/400 AP Shield to a nearby damaged ally for 4 seconds. Both of their next 3 attacks gain 40% Attack Speed and deal 35/55/80 AP bonus magic damage.

ability.name: Fungus Among Us
ability.desc: Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal 55/82/155 AP magic damage to the 3 nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals 135/200/310 AP magic damage to the target. Each cast has a 10%/12%/15% chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects. Red: 1 Reroll Green: 1 Tactician Health Yellow: 2 XP

ability.name: Jaws of The Beast
ability.desc: Bite the current target, dealing 230/345/535 AD physical damage and healing for 25% AP of the damage dealt. Gain 20% Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

ability.name: Cultivation of Spirit
ability.desc: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals 160/240/370 AD + 10/15/25 AP physical damage and splits, dealing 56/84/129.5 AD + 3.5/5.25/8.75 AP physical damage to 2 nearby enemies.

ability.name: Arise!
ability.desc: Gain 150% Attack Speed and summon 2 soldiers for the next 6 attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal 43/65/105 AP magic damage per attack.

ability.name: Noxious Blast
ability.desc: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing 400/600/950 AP magic damage over 15 seconds. Poisons stack.

ability.name: Pale Barrier
ability.desc: Gain 150/275/500 shield for 2 seconds and send out 6 moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing 75/115/180 AP magic damage.

ability.name: Harvest
ability.desc: Reduce the Magic Resist of the 3 nearest enemies by 10. Then drain life from them over 2 seconds, healing for 410/485/850 AP Health and dealing 70/105/170 AP magic damage to each over the duration.

ability.name: Spirit of Dread
ability.desc: Gain 50 Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore 375/475/685 AP Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the 3 nearest enemies, dealing 80/120/195 AP magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5/1.5/1.75 seconds.

ability.name: Taste Their Fear
ability.desc: Leap to the farthest enemy within 3 Hexes, dealing 230/310/450 AP magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal 250/350/530 AP magic damage instead and gain 10 mana.

ability.name: Raining Artillery
ability.desc: Adaptor AD: Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing 145/220/375 AD + 20/30/50 AP physical damage. Enemies below 50% max Health take 203/308/525 AD + 28/42/70 AP physical damage instead. Adaptor AP: Damages enemies over time.

ability.name: Rock and Roll
ability.desc: Passive: On death, split into two Kruglettes with 50/100/180 + 132/238/428 Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them. Active: Gain 175/225/325 AP max Health, then roll into the target, dealing 135/200/335 AD + 88/158.4/285.12 Health damage. Slate Buff: On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for 8% max Health.

ability.name: Flock Family
ability.desc: Summon 4 untargetable Tiny Beaks nearby for 5 AP seconds. Whenever Mama Beak attacks, Tiny Beaks attack the same enemy, dealing 20/30/50 AD physical damage. Orange Buff: Dealing physical damage reduces enemy Armor by 2.

alphaArmor.label: Orange Buff: Armor lost per physical hit

ability.name: Wuju Style
ability.desc: Passive: Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed. Adaptor AD: Double Strikes grant 12% + 3% AP stacking Attack Speed. Adaptor AP: Double Strikes deal bonus damage and heal.

every.label: Every nth attack is a Double Strike

as_.label: Stacking Attack Speed per Double Strike

asAp.label: Stacking Attack Speed per Double Strike

ability.name: Defensive Ball Curl
ability.desc: Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For 4 seconds, gain 400/550/700 AP Shield and 60 Armor and Magic Resist. When the Shield breaks, deal 25/37.5/60 Armor + 25/37.5/60 MR physical damage to enemies in 2 Hexes.

ability.name: Savagery
ability.desc: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within 3 hexes and stab them, dealing 255/385/650 AD physical damage. Then heal for 60/90/150 AP, increased to up to 120/180/300 AP based on their missing Health.

ability.name: Explosive Charge
ability.desc: Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts 4 seconds. While active, gain infinite range and 40% + 20% AP Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing 175/265/420 AD physical damage + 12/18/28 AD for each attack while casting.

ability.name: Furious Fists
ability.desc: Passive: On attack, restore 22/40/71 Health. Active: Unleash a primal roar, restoring 200/265/360 AP Health. Then gain 85%/100%/125% Attack Speed, 15% Durability, and is Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

ability.name: Spirit Bomb
ability.desc: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within 4 hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals 455/685/3500 AP magic damage to enemies in a 3 hex radius, reduced by 21% per hex away from the epicenter.

falloff.label: Less per hex from the center

ability.name: Tantrum
ability.desc: Passive: Every second, restore 20/25/100 AP + 33/59/168 Health and deal 12/18/150 AP magic damage to enemies within 1 hex. Active: Deal 100/150/2000 AP magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes and Stun them for 1/1/6 seconds, increased to 1/1/6 + 0.5/0.5/3 seconds if the target is Burning.

ability.name: Moonlight's Onslaught
ability.desc: Equip Severum and swipe the target 5 AS times over 2 seconds, each dealing 70/105/850 AD physical damage. After the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals 450/675/5000 AD + 40/60/225 AP physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

ability.name: Crimson Fury
ability.desc: Passive: When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing 135/205/1000 AD physical damage. Active: Gain 100%/100%/300% Attack Damage for 8 seconds. During this time ignore 10%/10%/70% AP + 30% Armor. Red Buff: Attacks 1% Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for 4% max Health.

ability.name: Forest's Flurry
ability.desc: Blink away from the current target, deal 270/405/1200 AD physical damage to them, and gain 30%/30%/100% AP Attack Speed. Every 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Nature's Wrath and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals 385/580/2500 AD physical damage, reduced by 25% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 50%).

ability.name: Lilting Lullaby
ability.desc: Restore 325/475/800 AP Health and send 4 butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take 90/135/2000 AP magic damage and Sleep for 1.5/1.75/8 seconds. If they take 1000 damage, they wake up and take an additional 10% max Health magic damage.

ability.name: Petrified Bark
ability.desc: Gain 735/885/2000 AP Shield for 4 seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing 40/60/2000 AP + 21/31.5/699.3 Armor + 21/31.5/699.3 MR magic damage to enemies within 2/2/3 hexes.

ability.name: Withering Curse
ability.desc: Passive: Gain 25% Omnivamp. Active: Fire a dark blast at 3 nearby enemies, dealing 70/105/500 AP magic damage to them and cursing them for 4 seconds. Then, spawn a 2 Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals 33/50/500 AP magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take 25/38/240 AP more damage per curse.

ability.name: Javelin Toss
ability.desc: Adaptor AP: Gain 150% Attack Speed for the next 3 attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal 185/275/2000 AP magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals 300/450/3000 AP magic damage. Adaptor AD: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.

ability.name: Azure Shockwave
ability.desc: Gain 375/475/2000 AP + 130/234/421.2 Health Shield for 4 seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take 100/150/3500 AP magic damage, and are Mana Reaved for 10. Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain 2 Mana Regen.

alphaRegen.label: Blue Buff: ally Mana Regen per cast

ability.name: Haymaker
ability.desc: Passive: Upon falling below 40% max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana. Active: Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for 144/259/467 Health + 250/300/2000 AP before dealing 72/129.6/233.28 Health + 150/225/5000 AD physical damage in a large cone.

ability.name: Boomerang Blade
ability.desc: Throw a large crossblade that deals 220/330/1050 AD + 15/20/100 AP physical damage to the current target and bounces 8 times between nearby enemies, dealing 40/59/420 AD + 3/4/40 AP physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce 3/3/6 additional times.

ability.name: Starcall
ability.desc: Call down a star on the current target, dealing 235/355/1000 AP magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down 3 additional stars that each deal 110/165/1000 AP magic damage.

ability.name: Rampant Growth
ability.desc: Spawn 2/2/4 plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy 10 times. Each attack deals 35/53/225 AP magic damage.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.desc: Rain 9 moonshards split among the 3 nearest enemies, dealing 58/88/500 AP magic damage each. If the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing 2350/3600/7500 AP magic damage split among all enemies.

ability.name: Spirit Rift
ability.desc: Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals 465/700/1000 AD physical damage, reduced by 80%/80%/40% per enemy hit (minimum 20%). The arrow leaves a trail for 4/4/20 seconds that deals 11/16/200 AD + 2/3/20 AP + 1.5%/1.5%/10% max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and 20% Slows them.

ability.name: Whirling Death
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals 150/225/3000 AD physical damage over 12 seconds. Every attack has a 12% AP chance to deal 50%/50%/900% bonus physical damage and apply 2 bleeds instead. Active: Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal 100/150/400 AD physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing 30/45/100 AD physical damage to enemies hit.

ability.name: Heat Without Equal
ability.desc: Passive: Attacks deal 75%/75%/100% damage to enemies adjacent to the target. Active: Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for 1.25/1.25/99 seconds, gain 15%/15%/100% Omnivamp, and Ignite them for 3/3/99 seconds. Ignited enemies take 2%/2%/20% max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it. Flame Breath: Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing 285/435/7000 AD + 20/30/200 AP physical damage, reduced by 20% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 20%.) Ignite those enemies for 3/3/99 seconds. Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below 12% Health executes them.

ability.name: Rage Gene
ability.desc: Passive: Gain 5/5/50 Rage per second and 5/5/20 Rage per attack. Active: Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within 3 hexes. Then, deal 100/150/2000 AD physical damage to enemies within 2/2/10 hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by 15/20/250 AP, and Stun them for 1/1/15 second. Mega Gnar gains 400/600/15000 Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw. Grab n' Throw: Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing 380/570/9000 AD physical damage to them and 135/205/4500 AD physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

ability.name: Triggerseed
ability.desc: Passive: Shields from this Ability can critically strike with Precision. Active: Grant 2/2/10 allies 185/350/3000 AP Amp Shield and 10%/15%/100% Damage Amp for 6 seconds. Then deal 155/235/2000 AP magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting 6 times, also grant 100% stacking Attack Speed to targets.

dmg.label: Damage to enemies adjacent to them

ability.name: Firestorm
ability.desc: Charge up, gaining 15% Ability Power per Burning enemy. Then, gain 230/300/3000 AP Shield for 2.5 seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing 80/120/1500 AP magic damage to each. After rushing, unleash a 2 Hex firestorm that deals a total of 475/715/5000 AP magic damage split among all enemies hit over 2 seconds.

ability.name: Final Spark
ability.desc: Passive: On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain 3/3/100 AP mana. Active: Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals 375/565/6500 AP magic damage, reduced by 25%/25%/10% for each enemy hit.

ability.desc: Passive: On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain 3/3/100 AP mana. Active: Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals 375/565/6500 AP magic damage, reduced by 25%/25%/10% for each enemy hit (minimum 40%). Blackthorn Bonus: Stuns targets hit for 1 second.

ability.name: Sow the Seeds
ability.desc: Passive: After every 650/650/300 damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals 80.5/144.9/2794.5 Health magic damage. On death, 3/5/10 saplings jump out. Active: Deal 69/124.2/3726 Health magic damage to target and restore 330/400/2000 AP + 10%/10%/100% missing Health.

growthRange.label: Old Growth: range of enemy deaths

growthHp.label: Old Growth: max Health per death

ability.name: Emerald Radiance
ability.desc: Passive: The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below 50% Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting 100/225/10000 + 195/351/4212 Health Shield to allies within 3 Hexes for 3/3/99 seconds. Active: Restore 250/375/3000 AP Health. Taric and his paired ally deal 130/200/1000 AP bonus magic damage on their next 2 attacks.

ability.name: Forest SMASH!
ability.desc: Passive: When an Elderwood unit dies heal for 54/97/175 Health and gain 80%/100%/250% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. Active: Slam the ground, dealing 500/750/750 AP magic damage to the target and 250/375/375 AP magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes. Knock up and Stun the target for 0.5 seconds.

heal.label: Heal when an Elderwood ally dies

as_.label: Attack Speed when an Elderwood ally dies

ability.name: Forest's Blessing
ability.desc: Passive: After 4 seconds of combat grant Elderwood allies 10%/15%/15% Attack Damage and Ability Power. Every 4 seconds thereafter, grant an additional 3%/5%/5% Attack Damage and 3%/5%/5% Ability Power.

first.label: Attack Damage and Ability Power after 4 s

ability.name: Forest's Protection
ability.desc: Passive: On death, Stun the nearest 2/3/3 enemies for 1.5 seconds.

traits.name: Elderwood
traits.desc: Gain placeable Elderwood plants. (3) A Stonebark Tree and a Lifebloom (5) A second Stonebark Tree and Stonebark Trees gain 200 Health (7) and the Deepwood Protector (9) Plants star up to 2-star (11) Plants star up to 3-star and the forest comes to life
traits.note: Place the plants yourself: they are in the Units list.

traits.name: Avatar
traits.desc: Having an Avatar on your bench or board transforms all other Avatars in your shop to the Trait of that Avatar. An Avatar's chosen Trait is counted twice for Trait bonuses.
traits.note: Each Lux counts its chosen trait twice.

traits.name: Ravager
traits.desc: Ravagers gain 10% Omnivamp. Additionally, Ravagers deal bonus damage, doubled against units below 50% Health. (2) 12% Bonus Damage (4) 25% Bonus Damage (6) 40% Bonus Damage

bonus.label: Bonus damage (doubled against units below 50% Health)

traits.name: Bounty Seeker
traits.desc: Choose a bounty. Your strongest Draven can progress on the bounty to earn its reward. Upon completing a bounty, choose another.

traits.name: Solar
traits.desc: (3) Your champions gain a 5% max Health shield and deal 8% bonus magic damage. Gain additional bonuses for each unique 3-star champion: 1: Increase shield and magic damage by 1% for each 3-star. 3: 15% Attack Speed and 12 Armor MR 5: Convert 40% of the bonus magic damage to true damage. 8: Every 4 seconds of combat, a 3-star champion ascends to 4-star.

resists.label: With 3 unique 3-stars: Armor and Magic Resist

traits.note: The Eclipse kills the lowest Health enemy when Solar and at least 3 Lunar are active.

traits.name: Sprykin
traits.desc: Gain the Big Furry Friend. Drop a Sprykin on the BFF to pick its Rider. (3) The Rider gains 15% Health and 15% Attack Speed (5) 40% Health 35% Attack Speed, and 50% of the BFF's Ability applies to your Sprykin champions. (7) 55% Health 55% Attack Speed, and 100% of the BFF's Ability applies to your Sprykin champions.
traits.note: The rider is the Sprykin with the most items. The BFF's own ability is not simulated.

traits.name: Adaptor
traits.desc: Innate: Adaptor abilities change depending on if their Attack Damage or Ability Power is higher. Adaptors gain Ability Power or Attack Damage, depending on which is higher. (2) 25% AD or AP (3) 35% AD or AP (4) 50% AD or AP

adap.label: Attack Damage or Ability Power, whichever is higher

traits.name: Coven
traits.desc: Gather Essence by killing champions, plus more by losing player combat. Beginning at 40 Essence, choose to convert Essence to rewards or continue gathering Essence. Each reward requires increasing amounts of Essence. (3) 2 Essence per kill, 22 Essence per loss (4) 2 per kill, 28 per loss (5) 3 per kill, 35 per loss (7) 10 per kill, 60 per loss
traits.note: Essence and its rewards are not simulated.

traits.name: Hunter
traits.desc: Hunters gain Attack Damage. If a Hunter hasn't swapped targets for 3 seconds, they gain 10% Damage Amp. (2) 20% AD (3) 30% AD (4) 45% AD (5) 60% AD

amp.label: Damage Amp when they haven't swapped targets

traits.name: Old Growth
traits.desc: Whenever an enemy within 3 hexes dies, your strongest Old Growth champion gains 30 permanent max Health.
traits.note: Its numbers are on Maokai's ability.

traits.name: Monolith
traits.desc: Monoliths gain 10 Armor and Magic Resist for each enemy targeting them.
